Talk selection, story context, participation and save validation use the same population.
Same-location protagonist map avatars ignore affinity; NPC avatars require current-viewpoint affinity >= 10 within 35 metres.
Scene shortcuts use the same 7 metre distance and prioritize protagonists.
Overlapping avatars have distinct hit areas and leaders; the 450ms gesture guard no longer swallows avatar clicks.
Selected 7 metre conversations suspend background routines in either viewpoint; phone access remains at 3 metres.
